107.3j-1: no_activation did not exercise the rule (no X is ever determined); dropped it.
107.3g-1: on_the_stack delta reworded to name the one fact it changes (the zone where the mana value is checked).
triage 107.3b: the forced X = 0 has an observable resolution outcome; reclassified decision -> mechanical and added 107.3b-1 (Omniscience, Blaze).

triage 107.4c, 107.4e, 107.4f: whether a {C}, hybrid or Phyrexian cost can be paid is a playability verdict no other unit covers; reclassified to legality and added 107.4c-1 (Matter Reshaper), 107.4e-1 (Dryad Militant), 107.4e-2 (Spectral Procession) and 107.4f-1 (Mutagenic Growth).

scenarios.title: A negative power used in an effect's calculation counts as zero while the creature's own power stays negative
decisions: A casts Hydrosurge targeting Chameleon Colossus, tapping Island; both players pass; Hydrosurge resolves and Chameleon Colossus (4/4) becomes -1/4.
A activates Chameleon Colossus's ability ({2}{G}{G}: it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power), tapping four Forests; both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: X is -1, the calculation of the bonus uses 0 instead, and Chameleon Colossus stays a -1/4 creature (not -2/3) until end of turn.

variants.label: no_hydrosurge
variants.delta: A does not cast Hydrosurge, so Chameleon Colossus is a 4/4 when the ability is activated.
variants.expected: X is 4 and Chameleon Colossus becomes an 8/8 until end of turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: Whether Forge's Pump clamps a negative X to 0 or adds it (giving -2/3) is exactly what this scenario probes.

scenarios.title: A creature with negative or zero power deals no combat damage and does not gain the opponent life

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since the turn began.

decisions: A casts Hydrosurge targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Island; both players pass; Hydrosurge resolves and Grizzly Bears (2/2) becomes -3/2.
A moves to combat and attacks B with Grizzly Bears; B declares no blockers.
Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has power -3 and toughness 2, assigns no combat damage, and B's life total stays 20 (it does not rise).

variants.label: growth_first
variants.delta: Before attacking, A also casts Giant Growth on Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest; it resolves.
variants.expected: Power is -3 + 3 = 0 and toughness 5, so Grizzly Bears is a 0/5, assigns no combat damage and B's life total stays 20 (not 17).

variants.label: no_hydrosurge
variants.delta: A does not cast Hydrosurge, so Grizzly Bears is a 2/2 when it attacks.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B and B's life total is 18.

scenarios.title: An X defined by the ability's text follows its current value while the ability is on the stack
decisions: A activates Chameleon Colossus's ability ({2}{G}{G}: it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power), tapping four Forests.
A holds priority and casts Giant Growth targeting Chameleon Colossus, tapping the fifth Forest.
Both players pass; Giant Growth resolves, then both players pass again and the pump ability resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Giant Growth makes Chameleon Colossus a 7/7 first; the ability then resolves with X = 7 and Chameleon Colossus is a 14/14 until end of turn.

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: A does not cast Giant Growth; the ability resolves with nothing in response.
variants.expected: The ability resolves with X = 4 and Chameleon Colossus is an 8/8 until end of turn; Giant Growth stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Relies on Forge evaluating Count$CardPower at resolution rather than at activation.

scenarios.title: A trigger referring to the X of another object uses the X that object was cast with

setup.notes: Zaxara has been under A's control since the turn began.

decisions: A casts Blaze with X = 2 targeting B, tapping three Mountains.
Zaxara's trigger goes on the stack above Blaze; both players pass and the trigger resolves, then both players pass and Blaze resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Zaxara's trigger fires and creates a green 0/0 Hydra token with 2 +1/+1 counters (a 2/2); Blaze then deals 2 damage and B's life total is 18.

variants.label: x_three
variants.delta: A casts Blaze with X = 3, tapping all four Mountains.
variants.expected: Zaxara's trigger fires and the Hydra token has 3 +1/+1 counters (a 3/3); Blaze deals 3 damage and B's life total is 17.

variants.label: x_zero
variants.delta: A casts Blaze with X = 0, tapping one Mountain.
variants.expected: Zaxara's trigger fires and the Hydra token gets 0 +1/+1 counters, so the 0/0 token moves to the graveyard in the state-based check; Blaze deals 0 damage and B's life total stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Zaxara's token count uses Count$xPaid inside a trigger; check that Forge reads the triggering spell's paid X. The rule has no does_not_fire branch: whenever the trigger refers to the cast spell's X, it uses it.

scenarios.title: The {X} in the mana cost of a card outside the stack counts as 0

setup.notes: Jadelight Spelunker has mana cost {X}{G}.

decisions: A casts Reanimate targeting the Jadelight Spelunker in A's graveyard, tapping Swamp; B passes; Reanimate resolves and A loses life equal to the creature's mana value.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: In the graveyard Jadelight Spelunker's {X}{G} has mana value 1, so A loses 1 life (life total 19) and Jadelight Spelunker enters the battlefield under A's control as a 1/1.

variants.label: no_x_card
variants.delta: The creature card in A's graveyard is Grizzly Bears instead of Jadelight Spelunker.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has mana value 2, so A loses 2 life (life total 18) and Grizzly Bears enters the battlefield.

variants.label: on_the_stack

variants.expected: As a spell on the stack Jadelight Spelunker has mana value 2 (X = 1 counts), so Spell Snare is legal and counters it; the countered Jadelight Spelunker moves to A's graveyard and A's life total stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the no_x_card variant A's graveyard holds Grizzly Bears in place of Jadelight Spelunker. Reanimate computes the life loss from the remembered last-known mana value.

variants.label: base
